description: Look up a domain's WHOIS registration record: registrar, creation and expiry dates, days remaining, name servers, and domain statuses, direct from the TLD registry. Registration data only — for DNS/mail health as well, use domain_health_check; for a combined report, use domain_report.

domain.description: Bare domain to look up, e.g. example.com (no scheme/path)

name: whois_lookup
